title: LLM response and session cost reporting
summary: `ILLMSession.AskStreamingAsync` will return typed stream items instead of plain strings: `LLMTextChunk` for text and `LLMUsageUpdate` for cost. A new `SessionCost` property gives the running total. This is a breaking change. CopilotLib emits an `LLMUsageUpdate` every time the Copilot SDK reports a usage event. Each update carries the cost of the current response so far and the session total, in dollars, where $ = AI credits / 100. When a session is resumed, its total is rebuilt from the stored session events. `ChatBotController` is adapted to keep streaming text only. Versions are bumped (LLMLib 0.3.0, CopilotLib 0.7.0), a CopilotLib.Tests project is added, and both packages are packed into local-nuget-feed so CodeAssistant can consume them.
findings: `ILLMSession.AskStreamingAsync` currently returns `IAsyncEnumerable<string>`. Callers: `ChatBotController` (LLMLib), plus CodeAssistant's TUI, WebApp `ChatConversation` and `FeaturePlanner`.

`CopilotLLMSession.AskStreamingAsync` subscribes with `_session.On<SessionEvent>` and only handles `AssistantMessageDeltaEvent`, `SessionErrorEvent` and `SessionIdleEvent`. Nothing reads usage or cost events today.
`CopilotService.OpenSessionAsync` resumes through `_client.ResumeSessionAsync`. `CopilotLLMSession.GetMessagesAsync` already shows how stored events are replayed with `_session.GetEventsAsync()`.

CopilotLib consumes LLMLib as a NuGet package (`Neph.GenericLibs.Net.LLMLib`), with its version pinned centrally in Directory.Packages.props (0.2.0). So LLMLib 0.3.0 must be packed into local-nuget-feed before CopilotLib can build against it.
Current versions are LLMLib 0.2.0 and CopilotLib 0.6.0. Packages are published to nuget.org by manual workflow_dispatch workflows and also stored in local-nuget-feed/.
The repository has no test projects. The code style uses tabs, Allman braces, explicit types and XML doc summaries.

phases.name: LLMLib API
phases.goal: Define the typed stream items and the new session contract in LLMLib, adapt `ChatBotController`, and bump LLMLib to 0.3.0.

tasks.title: Add typed stream item DTOs
tasks.description:
Create LLMs/LLMLib/DTO/LLMStreamItem.cs in namespace `LLMLib.DTO` with:
- `public abstract record LLMStreamItem;`
- `public sealed record LLMTextChunk(string Text) : LLMStreamItem;`
- `public sealed record LLMUsageUpdate(decimal ResponseCost, decimal SessionCost) : LLMStreamItem;`

Add XML docs:
- Costs are in US dollars.
- `ResponseCost` is the total for the current `AskStreamingAsync` call so far.
- `SessionCost` is the total for the whole session, including earlier turns and turns from before a resume.
- An update is emitted every time the provider reports usage.

Follow the repository style (tabs, block namespace).

tasks.title: Change ILLMSession contract
tasks.description:
In LLMs/LLMLib/ILLMSession.cs:
- Change `AskStreamingAsync` to return `IAsyncEnumerable<LLMStreamItem>`. Keep the same parameters.
- Update its summary: it streams `LLMTextChunk` items as text is generated, and an `LLMUsageUpdate` each time the provider reports usage.
- Add `decimal SessionCost { get; }` with the summary "Total cost of this session in US dollars, including turns made before it was resumed."

tasks.title: Adapt ChatBotController to typed items
tasks.description:
In LLMs/LLMLib/Controllers/ChatBotController.cs `ChatStream`:
- Iterate `IAsyncEnumerable<LLMStreamItem>`.
- For `LLMTextChunk text`, write `text.Text` and flush, exactly as before.
- Ignore every other item type, including `LLMUsageUpdate`.

Response headers and status codes stay unchanged.

tasks.title: Bump LLMLib to 0.3.0
tasks.description:
Make these version changes:
- In LLMs/LLMLib/LLMLib.csproj, set `<Version>0.3.0</Version>`.
- In Directory.Packages.props, set `Neph.GenericLibs.Net.LLMLib` to `0.3.0` so CopilotLib consumes the new API.

phases.name: CopilotLib cost tracking
phases.goal: Turn Copilot SDK usage events into `LLMUsageUpdate` items, track the session total including history on resume, and bump CopilotLib to 0.7.0.

tasks.title: Confirm SDK usage event and add CopilotUsageTracker
tasks.description:
First, inspect GitHub.Copilot.SDK 1.0.34 (IntelliSense, or the package XML docs under the NuGet cache) and identify the session event that reports billing for each model call. Most likely this is `AssistantUsageEvent` ("assistant.usage"). Find the field that holds AI credits or nano-AIU, and its unit. Record the conversion in a code comment, for example `credits = nanoAiu / 1_000_000_000m`.

Then create LLMs/CopilotLib/CopilotUsageTracker.cs, an `internal sealed class CopilotUsageTracker` with:
- `internal const decimal AiCreditsPerDollar = 100m`.
- `internal static decimal ToDollars(decimal aiCredits) => aiCredits / AiCreditsPerDollar`.
- `internal static decimal? GetAiCredits(SessionEvent evt)`. It returns the credits of a usage event, `0` when the event is a usage event with a null field, and `null` for non-usage events.
- `internal static decimal SumSessionCost(IEnumerable<SessionEvent> events)`. It returns the dollar total of all usage events.
- A constructor `CopilotUsageTracker(decimal initialSessionCost)`.
- A thread-safe `decimal SessionCost` property (use a `Lock`; decimals can't use `Interlocked`).
- `void BeginResponse()`, which resets the response total to 0.
- `LLMUsageUpdate AddCredits(decimal aiCredits)`. It adds `ToDollars(aiCredits)` to both the response and session totals and returns `new LLMUsageUpdate(responseCost, sessionCost)`.

Add `<InternalsVisibleTo Include="CopilotLib.Tests" />` to CopilotLib.csproj.

tasks.title: Stream typed items from CopilotLLMSession
tasks.description:
In LLMs/CopilotLib/CopilotLLMSession.cs:
- Add a `CopilotUsageTracker _usage` field. Change the internal constructor to `CopilotLLMSession(CopilotSession session, string sessionId, decimal initialSessionCost)`.
- Implement `public decimal SessionCost => _usage.SessionCost;`.
- In `AskStreamingAsync` (now returning `IAsyncEnumerable<LLMStreamItem>`), use `Channel<LLMStreamItem>` and call `_usage.BeginResponse()` before subscribing.
- In the event handler:
  - `AssistantMessageDeltaEvent`: write `new LLMTextChunk(delta.Data.DeltaContent)`.
  - Any event where `CopilotUsageTracker.GetAiCredits(evt)` is not null: write `_usage.AddCredits(credits)`.
  - Keep the existing error and idle handling.

Usage events that arrive after `SessionIdleEvent` aren't delivered for that call, since the subscription is disposed. If the SDK sends the usage event after idle, complete the channel only once both have arrived, or document the behaviour after checking the event order in T2.1.

`GetMessagesAsync` and `DisposeAsync` stay unchanged.

tasks.title: Rebuild session cost on resume
tasks.description:
In LLMs/CopilotLib/CopilotService.cs:
- `CreateSessionAsync`: construct `new CopilotLLMSession(session, sessionId, 0m)`.
- `OpenSessionAsync`: after `GetSessionAsync`, call `IReadOnlyList<SessionEvent> events = await session.GetEventsAsync(cancellationToken)`. Then construct `new CopilotLLMSession(session, sessionId, CopilotUsageTracker.SumSessionCost(events))`.

Log the restored cost at Debug level (session id and cost).

phases.name: Tests and packaging
phases.goal: Cover the cost logic with tests and publish both packages to the local feed for CodeAssistant.

tasks.title: Create CopilotLib.Tests project
tasks.description:
Create LLMs/CopilotLib.Tests/CopilotLib.Tests.csproj:
- net10.0, `IsPackable=false`, `NoWarn GHCP001`.
- A `ProjectReference` to ../CopilotLib/CopilotLib.csproj.
- Packages `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk`, `xunit.v3` (or `xunit` 2.x) and `xunit.runner.visualstudio`, with their versions added to Directory.Packages.props.
- Add the project to GenericLibs.Net.slnx under the /LLMs/ folder.

Add CopilotUsageTrackerTests.cs with these unit tests:
- (a) `ToDollars(250m) == 2.5m`.
- (b) A new tracker with initial cost 1.00: `AddCredits(10)` then `AddCredits(5)` gives updates (0.10, 1.10) and (0.15, 1.15), and `SessionCost == 1.15`.
- (c) `BeginResponse()` resets `ResponseCost` but not `SessionCost`.
- (d) `SumSessionCost` over a list with two usage events and unrelated events returns the dollar sum of the usage events only. Build the SDK event instances directly if their constructors are public, otherwise deserialize them from JSON.

Add CopilotSessionCostIntegrationTests.cs. It is skipped unless the `COPILOT_TEST_TOKEN` environment variable is set. It builds a `CopilotService` with that token as `ConnectionStrings:Copilot`, then:
- creates a session and asks "Reply with the single word OK";
- asserts that at least one `LLMTextChunk` and at least one `LLMUsageUpdate` were streamed;
- asserts that the last update's `SessionCost` equals `session.SessionCost` and is >= its `ResponseCost`;
- disposes the session, reopens it with `OpenSessionAsync`, and asserts that `SessionCost` equals the previous total;
- deletes the session.

tasks.title: Pack LLMLib then CopilotLib into local-nuget-feed
tasks.description:
From the repository root, run these commands in order:
1. `dotnet pack LLMs/LLMLib/LLMLib.csproj -c Release -o local-nuget-feed`
2. `dotnet restore LLMs/CopilotLib/CopilotLib.csproj`, which picks up LLMLib 0.3.0 from the local feed.
3. `dotnet pack LLMs/CopilotLib/CopilotLib.csproj -c Release -o local-nuget-feed`

This produces Neph.GenericLibs.Net.LLMLib.0.3.0.nupkg and Neph.GenericLibs.Net.CopilotLib.0.7.0.nupkg; commit them like the existing packages. Publishing to nuget.org is done separately through the workflows publish-llmlib-nuget.yml and publish-copilotlib-nuget.yml (LLMLib first). The CodeAssistant plan depends on this task.

Its `ResponseCost` is the dollar total of this response so far (X/100 summed) and its `SessionCost` is C0 plus `ResponseCost`. `session.SessionCost` matches it.

Typed stream items (text chunk and usage update).
Write only text items to the response.

decisions: Cost is GitHub AI credits converted to dollars, using $ = AI credits / 100 (the user's definition).

Breaking API change (the user chose it): `AskStreamingAsync` returns `IAsyncEnumerable<LLMStreamItem>`. `LLMStreamItem` is an abstract record with two sealed subtypes: `LLMTextChunk(string Text)` and `LLMUsageUpdate(decimal ResponseCost, decimal SessionCost)`.

An `LLMUsageUpdate` is emitted for each usage event the provider reports, so a response that makes several model calls (tool loops) produces several updates. `ResponseCost` is the total for the current `AskStreamingAsync` call so far. `SessionCost` is the total of earlier turns plus `ResponseCost`.
`ILLMSession` gets `decimal SessionCost { get; }` (read-only), so callers can show the total before the first reply, for example for resumed sessions.
A session resumed with `OpenSessionAsync` starts from the sum of all usage events in its stored history (the user chose this). New sessions start at 0.
`ChatBotController` keeps streaming text only and returns no cost (the user chose this).
Version bumps: LLMLib 0.3.0 (breaking, minor bump while below 1.0) and CopilotLib 0.7.0.
The usage-to-dollar arithmetic lives in an internal `CopilotUsageTracker` in CopilotLib, so it can be unit-tested without a live Copilot connection.
outOfScope: Showing or returning cost in `ChatBotController` responses.
Cost reporting in OpenAILib (it doesn't implement `ILLMService`).
Configurable price tables, token-count reporting and quota snapshots.
Adding cost to `ChatSessionInfo` or to `GetSessionsAsync` listings.
furtherConsiderations: The exact SDK usage event and the AI-credit field and unit must be confirmed against GitHub.Copilot.SDK 1.0.34 (T2.1). If the SDK only exposes a premium-request multiplier, the AI-credit conversion needs to be revisited with the user.
If usage events can arrive after `SessionIdleEvent`, the channel-completion logic in T2.2 must wait for them; otherwise the last update of a turn would only show up in the rebuilt total on resume.
Since this is a breaking change, any other consumers of LLMLib or CopilotLib outside CodeAssistant must be updated before they upgrade.
`CopilotService`'s default model string "claude-sonnet5.5" looks like a typo of "claude-sonnet-5.5". It is unrelated and left unchanged.
